name: Deen Dayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme
benefit:
The Deen Dayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS) provides a wide range of benefits to persons with disabilities, including:

_eligibility_text:
1. Organizations registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, or relevant Act of the State/Union Territory.
1. A public trust that is registered under the law temporarily.
1. A charitable company that is licensed under Section 25 of the Companies Act 1958.
1. The organization must have been in existence for at least two years.
1. The organization must have a properly constituted governing body with its power, duties, and responsibilities mentioned in writing.
1. The organization must have the resources, facilities, and experience to undertake the proposed project.
1. The organization should not be run for the profit of any individual or a body of individuals.
1. The organization should not discriminate against any individual or a group with respect to their sex, religion, caste, or creed
